reference.title: Reference meter
reference.description: Pick the meter that measures power per phase on your main fuse, such as a P1/DSMR reader. Its L1, L2 and L3 are the labels Phase Finder reports. Choose a meter that follows the grid company's phase order.

reference_manual.title: Reference meter
reference_manual.description: Pick the power sensor for each phase. If the meter reports import and export as separate sensors, also pick the export sensors: they are subtracted.

extra.title: More meters (optional)
extra.description: A second meter on the main fuse, such as an inverter's grid meter, can report more often than the reference ({reference}) and so find more phases. Phase Finder learns how its phase labels match the reference's before using it, so its A/B/C order does not matter. Do not pick sub-meters that measure only part of the house.
